profile.description: Sensient Technologies is a global manufacturer and marketer of colors, flavors and fragrances based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Their products are used in many foods and beverages, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, home and personal care products, specialty printing and imaging products, computer imaging and industrial colors.
profile.description_zh: Sensient Technologies 是一家全球性的色素、香精和香料制造商及销售商，总部位于威斯康星州密尔沃基，其产品广泛应用于食品饮料、药品、化妆品、家居及个人护理产品、特种印刷与成像产品、计算机成像及工业色素领域。
